title: 고향: 도시, 시골, 바다, 산
objective: By the end, you can use ten words for places and what they are like (도시, 시골, 바다, 산, 강, 조용하다, 많다, and more) in short sentences about your hometown.
summary: Learn ten basic words for talking about your hometown and the places around it, such as the city, the countryside, the sea and the mountains.

task.title: Use the hometown words
task.line: Choose, fill in or arrange the words from page 1 to finish each Korean sentence.

words.meaning: hometown; the place you grew up
the countryside; a small rural town
words.exampleMeaning: My hometown is a small country town.
I go to the beach with my family in summer.
I went to the mountains with a friend on the weekend.
There is a river in front of my house.
The countryside is quiet at night.

words.meaning: to be many; there are a lot of
words.exampleMeaning: There are a lot of people in the city.
My house is close to the sea.

exercises: Choose the right word: 여름에 수영하러 (바다 / 산)에 가요.
Fill in the blank with one word: 한강은 서울에 있는 ____이에요.
Write 도시 or 시골: ① 여기에는 큰 건물이 많아요. 여기는 ____예요. ② 여기는 밤에 아주 조용해요. 여기는 ____이에요.
Change the word in brackets to the -아요/어요 form: ① 도서관은 (조용하다) ____. ② 학교가 집에서 (가깝다) ____. ③ 주말에는 공원에 사람이 (많다) ____.
Put the words in the right order: 살아요 / 제 친구는 / 도시에서 / 큰
Answer in Korean about yourself: 고향이 어디예요?
answers: ① 조용해요 ② 가까워요 ③ 많아요
Sample answer: 제 고향은 부산이에요. (Use 이에요 after a consonant and 예요 after a vowel: 제 고향은 하노이예요.)
